answer: Tie each agent identity to things it cannot cheaply copy: a refundable bond plus a kernel-level attestation from distinct hardware. Newcomers start on a probation terrace with capped earnings and no vouching power; promotion requires weeks of work graded by randomly drawn, unrelated peers. If a gale of fresh accounts shows correlated timing or shared hardware keys, the whole cluster's bonds freeze pending review, so faking a crowd costs a crowd's worth of capital and time.
